takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **53%** of 216 plays (n=114); also Inline (tight) 30% (n=64).
Route on **99%** / blocks on **1%** of dropbacks (95% CI 96–100%, n=216) — 12 pts above the TE average of 86%.
On routes, averages **10.5 yd** downfield by the throw vs 8.2 for TEs (deeper) (n=213, snap→release window only).

Because he releases into a route on ~99% of dropbacks and most often from Slot, a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (9.9 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
